Storm knocks out power across three counties

A line of severe thunderstorms swept across the region on Monday evening, knocking out power to more than forty thousand customers in three counties and bringing down trees across dozens of roads.

Utility crews worked through the night, and the company said most customers should have power back by Wednesday. Schools in two districts announced they would open two hours late on Tuesday.

No serious injuries were reported, but officials urged residents to stay away from downed lines and to treat any dark traffic signal as a four-way stop until power is restored to the area.
